about: Plan 6.10: a second English spelling set, built differently from the moby dev split (synthetic one-edit typos in 1851 prose). Modern sentences, each with 1-2 of the well-known everyday misspellings (cognitive and phonetic errors such as recieve, seperate, definately, many of them two edits away). Written for this repo by the cloud lane g2-L7 (Claude), CC0-1.0; no third-party corpus. A misspelling the en-US dictionary accepts is a real-word error, out of scope for a non-word checker, and is left out (same rule as moby). Not the held-out test split: that one is still built by CI with GOLDEN_SEED.
